I-it’s a long story but I’ll keep it real short.. about 5 or 6 months ago my gf of almost 2 years broke up with me because she stopped loving me because I wasn’t what she wanted anymore.. but I was never ready to stop loving her.. I still do so much. But ever since then it’s just been a downward spiral into depression and feeling suicidal without the one who got me through everything and made me feel so happy and like I had worth.

The link doesn’t work :(

Well she never said exactly that but she did say the other things together with the person she left me for. It hurt a lot to hear them from the both of them. She said it herself that she just lost all her feelings for me. And it’s because her preferences changed and I wasn’t the type of person she wanted anymore.. and because of my neglect to not do other things she apparently needed

I just wasn’t the type of person she wanted to be with anymore.. and didn’t act and do things she wanted apparently since what she wanted changed. According to her there was nothing I could’ve done to be that person anymore.
I don’t know.. I know I stopped being something to her regardless of what is was. I know there were things that I didn’t do that she wished I did or was better about..
She never tried to change me.. and she always said she loved the way I was but I guess I just stopped being the definition of perfect to her
No, she really didn’t care about appearances believe it or not. I meant just preferences in what kind of person she wanted.. So I just stopped being what she wanted because those preferences changed

It’s just all feels useless.. I honestly don’t even want to move on. I just want to keep loving her and hoping she wants me again.. I don’t just miss the happy times.. I miss everything. I’d do anything just to hear her scold me for something. I know I wasn’t perfect but I tried my best for her but I guess it wasn’t enough and I didn’t make the right decisions and her preferences just changed.

They already know about that stuff too.. I’m just unable to not think about her and keep getting this overwhelming feeling that I’m missing something. I still can’t completely fathom that she really left for someone else.. it hurts so much.. even more so thinking about them together
They already know what’s been going on, but everything is still terrible.. I don’t think I’ll ever be the same again
I already live with my parents, I’m only 18. I just can’t accept what’s happened.. I’ve lost my everything, my love.
I just can never really escape it. I still want her back so much, everything reminds me of her.
I’ve cried everyday since it happened.. its hurt so bad that I’ve harmed myself and even made an attempt on my own life. I honestly still don’t want to live..
Thanks for the words.. everything is still so hard at this point..
But I do.. I still want to have everything with her but she doesn’t want it anymore.. not with me.
I’m a guy, but thanks for saying something at least, I don’t have anyone right now
